description: This file defines a use case class `GetFollowableTopicsUseCase` that retrieves a list of topics with their follow status, optionally sorted by a specified field. It leverages repositories to fetch user data and topics, and combines this data to produce a flow of followable topics.

classes.name: GetFollowableTopicsUseCase
classes.description: A use case class responsible for fetching and returning a list of topics with their follow status, optionally sorted.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes the use case to combine user data and topics into a list of followable topics, sorted based on the parameter.
